fields.description:
Wire the copilot, codex, and claude client configs to connect to the rebar MCP endpoint over remote
HTTP with a `static` bearer PAT (ADR deft-evolutive-mosasaur; PATs from exuberant-blockish-avians).
Single concern: the three client-side config shapes + a basic read-tool smoke — the endpoint/edge is
esok, the credentials are avians, live prod verification is jackal.

## Relationship to the already-landed avians artifacts (no duplication)
avians already committed the repo-root placeholder template `mcp-clients.local.example.json` (copied
to the gitignored `mcp-clients.local.json`) and the runbook `infra/runbooks/mcp-client-pats.md`
(step 4 "Wire each client locally", provisioning + rotation, box env vars
`MCP_CLIENT_PAT_{COPILOT,CODEX,CLAUDE}`). This ticket does NOT restate that provisioning/rotation
model; the new setup doc links to the runbook and template and adds only the missing piece — the
concrete per-client config SHAPE for copilot/codex/claude. The example configs reuse the same env
var names and the same gitignored local file.

## Approach + rationale (static bearer for all three; sourced from client `--help`)
All three clients support a static `Authorization: Bearer <PAT>` header for a remote HTTP MCP server
and none require OAuth, so one auth shape covers all three (surfaces verified against each client's
own `--help` / official docs, cited in the setup doc):
- **Copilot** (`copilot mcp add --transport http --header "Authorization: Bearer $VAR"`, per
  `copilot mcp add --help`): `~/.copilot/mcp-config.json` — a `type: http` rebar entry with the HTTPS
  `/mcp/` URL and a `headers` map `Authorization: Bearer $MCP_CLIENT_PAT_COPILOT` (the CLI expands
  `$VAR` from the environment, so no PAT literal is stored).
- **Codex** (`bearer_token_env_var`, per developers.openai.com/codex Streamable-HTTP config):
  `~/.codex/config.toml` — a `[mcp_servers.rebar]` streamable-HTTP entry with
  `bearer_token_env_var = "MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX"` so the PAT comes from the environment.
- **Claude** (`claude mcp add --transport http --header`, per code.claude.com/docs mcp): `.mcp.json`
  (`type: http`, `headers` `Authorization: Bearer ${MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLAUDE}`). Document the gotcha: a
  static header takes precedence and does NOT fall back to OAuth if rejected, so a wrong/expired PAT
  fails hard (not a silent OAuth retry).
Each references the gitignored credential (env var / `mcp-clients.local.json`), never an inline
secret. Ship copy-ready example configs under `examples/mcp-clients/` plus a setup doc; the three
client-home files themselves are not committed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tier: **real client config load + a basic read-tool call**, made hermetic by spinning up a
  local `rebar-mcp` HTTP instance on loopback with a known static token — no network, no external
  service. Oracles:
  - Real-tool-result (client-agnostic, always runs in CI): a client-agnostic structural loader
    parses each committed example config, validates it against that client's documented schema, and
    resolves the bearer via the client's documented env-var substitution; the loopback `rebar-mcp`
    then serves a real read tool (a ticket `show`/`list`) for the resolved `Authorization: Bearer`
    header — oracle: a real tool result payload, not just "connected".
  - Contrast (§6, always runs): the same loopback server returns 401 for an absent/invalid bearer,
    confirming the header is actually on the request path (not a hang).
  - Client-binary acceptance (skips-with-reason when the CLI is absent, so CI without the binaries
    still passes): where installed, `copilot mcp get rebar` / `codex mcp list` / `claude mcp list`
    load the committed example config and list the `rebar` server. Each such check is individually
    guarded by `shutil.which`/`pytest.skip("<client> CLI not installed")`.
- [ ] No secret is committed (the PAT is sourced from the avians env var / gitignored file); a test
  asserts no PAT literal appears in any committed example config (only an env-var reference).

## Testing / Verification
- Proof command: `make test PYTEST_ARGS=tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_client_configs.py`.
  The real-tool-result assertion, the 401 contrast, and the no-secret grep run unconditionally
  (they need only the in-repo loopback `rebar-mcp`); the per-client CLI acceptance checks
  skip-with-reason when that client binary is not installed, so the suite is green in a hermetic CI
  runner that lacks copilot/codex/claude.
- Full gate: `make lint && make typecheck && make test`.

## Compat / rollback
Additive client config; rollback = remove the `examples/mcp-clients/` files + the setup doc. No
server-side change.

Depends on: cibophobic-holohedral-esok (reachable endpoint), exuberant-blockish-avians (PATs).
Blocks: creased-childlike-jackal (live prod verification).
